items: 1. Our patellar tendon support strap is designed for daily use—walking, running, or gym workouts. This patella band promotes better joint alignment, helps relieve knee pain, and supports an active, pain-free lifestyle.

2. From basketball, tennis, and volleyball to cycling and fitness, this patella knee brace stays in place during intense movement. The knee strap delivers targeted support so you can train harder, jump higher, and recover faster without slipping.

3. Our patella band for knee pain applies steady pressure to the tendon, helping ease discomfort from meniscus tear, rodilleras para dolor de rodillas, or general knee pain. Perfect for running, hiking, or badminton, it keeps you moving.

4. Our patella knee brace features an adjustable Velcro strap for personalized compression, fitting knee sizes 11–18 inches (28–46 cm). Perfect for gym, workout, or fitness, it provides support that adapts to your needs.

5. Made with soft, high-elastic silicone, this patellar tendon support strap molds to your kneecap for secure comfort. Whether for cycling, exercise, fitness, or recovery from knee pain, it provides stable support that moves with you all day.
